svg.title: Тяга каната к груди на блоке — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated rope cable row to sternum, side-three-quarter view. One exercise bench with person seated upright, both feet planted. Cable tower in front with pulley set at chest height. One distinct short Y-shaped braided rope attachment with two thick end stopper knobs, held with one end in each hand. Cable runs continuously horizontal from chest-high pulley to rope midpoint. LEFT arms stretch forward toward the pulley, rope ends together. RIGHT elbows pull back and separate rope ends beside lower chest, rope midpoint reaches sternum level, hands never higher than shoulders. Keep exact same seat, foot placement, and rope both panels. Do not draw a face pull or straight bar. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
